shared_elements: horizontal band or register of repeated signs or motifs
justification: The most specific overlap is that both include profile avian or avian-like imagery with wings/feathers, together with horizontal registers of repeated signs or motifs above other figural carving. The major difference is that A is a single large, detailed winged bird-headed humanoid holding ritual objects and flanked by plants, while B is a stacked field of schematic animals and abstract symbols without the same central figure, objects, or flanking vegetation.
